notes:
Account background:
- Mid-sized fintech focusing on client-facing search across legal docs, transaction logs, compliance reports.
- Heavy regulatory constraints; must keep PII and transaction text in EU/UK only.

POC / technical requirements:
- Indexing scale: ~120M canonical documents; average chunk size ~400 tokens; expect 1–2B embedding vectors after chunking.
- Target QPS: baseline 40 qps sustained, burst to 250 qps during market open.
- Latency SLOs: median < 50ms for vector search (regional), p95 end-to-end < 250ms including reranker.
- Cost sensitivity: target cost per query < €0.003 at production scale; procurement requires cost model for dedicated vs private.
- Model preferences: open embeddings (SBERT-like) + custom reranker (fine-tuned cross-encoder). Need guidance on quantized LLM reranker (8-bit) tradeoffs.
- Routing/failover: active region = eu-west-2, passive eu-west-1; automated failover with read-only degraded mode acceptable. Must not replicate raw text to non-EU regions.

Security / legal notes:
- Must support SSO (SAML), KMS integration, audit logs retention 3 years, and explicit EU/UK data residency clause in contract.
- Legal expects architecture diagram and data flow for CISO review.

Commercial / process:
- Procurement timeline: security sign-off -> POC acceptance -> procurement (expected Apr 2026).
- ARR target (internal): €250k–€600k annual if SLA & residency satisfied.
- Pricing sensitivity: procurement threshold for unit cost; customer asked for a blended cost model showing caching/batching benefits.

Quotes / callouts:

- Wants a POC metric: 1) 50ms median search, 2) reranker lift > 7% NDCG@10 on held-out queries.
